readings: Total up each customer's invoice totals and work out each customer's share of overall revenue (their total over the sum across all customers). Keep the customers whose share is above the average share. Give one row with: the average amount those customers spent, their average share, and on average how much their share beats the average share. No rounding.
queries:
WITH cust AS (
  SELECT CustomerId, SUM(Total) AS total
  FROM Invoice
  GROUP BY CustomerId
),
shares AS (
  SELECT CustomerId, total, total * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(total) FROM cust) AS share
  FROM cust
),
avg_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) AS a FROM shares
)
SELECT AVG(total) AS avg_spent,
       AVG(share) AS avg_share,
       AVG(share - (SELECT a FROM avg_share)) AS avg_excess
FROM shares
WHERE share > (SELECT a FROM avg_share);
